notes.title: 0.5.0 (Testers)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-EFSN8lmneU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Version 0.5.0 is live for all testers and introduces the following changes and additions:[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved physics
[*] Improved reflections
[*] 8 new cars added
[*] New driver camera
[*] Steering wheel turning
[*] New mountain region
[*] New drift spots
[*] New drift zone challenges
[*] New city layout (incomplete)
[*] New songs added
[*] Spoilers
[*] Improved textures & compression
[*] New object pooling/culling system
[*] Other performance improvements
[*] Improved foliage & new palm trees
[*] Disabled rev-limiter to allow drifting at high RPM
[/list]

We are now working on finishing all the goals for version 0.6.0, which will also mark the early access on steam!

notes.title: 0.4.8 (Testers)
notes.content:
Update 0.4.8: Small improvements and fixes before 0.5 release

Improved reflections
Fixed reflection probe projection
Grass render distance changes per quality level
Grip slightly increased
New emissive textures for brake lights
